short: Matching your supplier ledger against the supplier's own statement.
seoTitle: Vendor Reconciliation — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: Matching your supplier ledger against the supplier's own statement. Supplier disputes get harder with age. Part of the free Setu business glossary.
definition: Vendor reconciliation compares your record of what you owe a supplier against their statement of what they say you owe, and explains every difference — unrecorded invoices, missing credit notes, payments in transit.
bodyHtml:
Why Vendor Reconciliation matters

Supplier disputes get harder with age. Reconciling quarterly turns a year-long argument into a short list of items both sides can still remember and evidence.

How Vendor Reconciliation works in practice

Request a statement, match invoice by invoice, and list differences by cause rather than as one net figure. Missing credit notes for returns are usually the largest single category.

faq.question: How often should I reconcile with suppliers?
faq.answer: Quarterly for regular suppliers, and always before agreeing a large settlement or closing an account.

faq.question: What causes most differences?
faq.answer: Unrecorded credit notes for returns, invoices never received, and payments applied to the wrong invoice.
